selection: Next 24 train members of round32 pre-response uniform paper-group lock, excluding every previously requested page and exposed cached ID. No dev-error, model-score or keyword targeting; failed/mismatched/overlength sources are excluded and disclosed, never replaced.

pipelineComparison: Same five fully reviewed round36 dev abstracts, including zero-pair ITO; fixed old entity-marker RE. Compare title NER, round35 NER and expanded NER without adjusting gates or labels.
